text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Monthly mean net power on weekdays 09:00 to 16:59 minus a per-site fit (calendar-month effect plus linear trend) to the months outside the grey window, in points of effective capacity. D14 enters in July 2020 after its early-calibration cut. Dotted lines: plus and minus 5 points.'
text.tspan: Monthly mean net power on weekdays 09:00 to 16:59 minus a per-site fit (calendar-month effect
plus linear trend) to the months outside the grey window, in points of effective capacity. D14
enters in July 2020 after its early-calibration cut. Dotted lines: plus and minus 5 points.
